item.title: LSCP hosts Breakfast and Business focusing on economic outlook for 2026
item.description: On Friday morning, the Lake Superior Community Partnership (LSCP) welcomed a panel of local economic partners to discuss a few 2026 projections during its first Breakfast and Business meeting of the year. The morning also included a special announcement from the CEO of the LSCP.
